alpha_quartz_surface_3_subtask_structure.name: SiO2 Structure Retrieval for Surface Area - Level 3
alpha_quartz_surface_3_subtask_structure.description: Retrieve structure of alpha-quartz SiO2 and convert it to LAMMPS data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

alpha_quartz_surface_3_subtask_potential.name: SiO2 Potential File for Surface Energy - Level 3
alpha_quartz_surface_3_subtask_potential.description: Procure an appropriate Tersoff potential file for alpha-quartz SiO2 for MD simulations. Return the absolute path of the potential file.

alpha_quartz_surface_3_bulk_energy_minim.name: SiO2 Bulk Minimisation for Surface Energy - Level 3
alpha_quartz_surface_3_bulk_energy_minim.description: Given paths to LAMMPS-compatible alpha-quartz SiO2 structure file and Tersoff potential file, perform bulk relaxation. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in eV and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
alpha_quartz_surface_3_bulk_energy_minim.submission_format: {"BULK ENERGY": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"BULK ENERGY": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structure/structure.dat"}

alpha_quartz_surface_3_slab_energy_minim.name: SiO2 Slab Relaxation for Surface Energy - Level 3
alpha_quartz_surface_3_slab_energy_minim.description: Given paths to LAMMPS-compatible alpha-quartz SiO2 structure file and Tersoff potential file, create a slab in the given direction by removing periodic boundary conditions along that direction. Perform structure relaxation. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in eV and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
alpha_quartz_surface_3_slab_energy_minim.submission_format: {"SLAB ENERGY": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"SLAB ENERGY": "42.78", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/slab_structure.dat"}

alpha_quartz_surface_3_surface.name: SiO2 Surface Energy Calculation - Level 3
alpha_quartz_surface_3_surface.description: Given the paths to LAMMPS-compatible relaxed bulk and slab structures of alpha-quartz SiO2, and their total energies (in eV), compute the surface energy. Return the surface energy in eV/Å².
